title: An exact mediator approximation preserves the ground code but loses secular logical coherence
statement: For H_e=(Delta I+e Z_L) tensor |1><1|_a and fixed coupling I_L tensor X_a, e=0 preserves L forever. Every e>0 splits transitions into logical-label-resolving jumps. With downward rate r and upward r exp(-beta E), the optimal arbitrary CPTP decoder has F_opt(t)=(1+exp(-Gamma_e t))/2, Gamma_e=r exp(-beta Delta) cosh(beta e). Negativity proves the upper bound; tracing out the mediator attains it.
